amy-recruiter: Offer verbally accepted for Arjun Patel. Requested payroll start 2026-04-01 but wants to attend mandatory training week starting 2026-03-15. Can we do unpaid preboarding + one-off bridge payment? cc @sam-people-ops @hiring-manager
people-ops-bot: New offer created: req#99882 (link: https://people-portal.internal/offers/99882)
people-ops-bot: ```summary:
 candidate: Arjun Patel
 requested_payroll_start: 2026-04-01
 training_start: 2026-03-15
 location: UK-remote
 sign_on_requested: GBP 7,500
 payroll_entity: Redwood UK Ltd```
sam-people-ops: Quick checklist: right-to-work verified? payroll entity confirmed? Any relocation payments?
amy-recruiter: RTW = passport verified, payroll = Redwood UK. No relocation. Training is virtual product immersion + LMS tasks.
benefits-team: Reminder: auto-enroll pension is based on payroll date and first full pay period. Preboarding cannot trigger benefits. If we pay a bridge stipend we must tax it and it will be pensionable if processed via payroll.
legal-escalations: Use the unpaid preboarding clause template `preboarding_unpaid_v3`. Also note: any sign-on > GBP 5k must be routed through comp-exception to comp-committee. Include rationale for bridge (retention risk) and attach manager statement.
finance-ops: Finance preference is to process one-off sign-on via payroll (taxed, NI applied) rather than external vendor. If processed outside payroll, we'd need a separate supplier invoice workflow. Also, RSU grant vesting/proration aligns to payroll start - grant effective date equals payroll start for calculations.
hiring-manager: We need the candidate in training the week of 3/15 to hit our release ramp. Manager supports a one-off GBP 3,000 bridge payment (contingent on completion).
sam-people-ops: Plan: I'll open a comp-exception request now routing to manager -> finance -> legal -> comp-committee if over threshold. I'll include manager statement and training checklist. Can we get a fast-track? candidate's last day is 3/31 so need decision by 3/10.
people-ops-bot: Comp-exception ticket PEOPLE-99882 created and routed to hiring-manager at 2801234570.
amy-recruiter: Thanks. Please also confirm we can mark training as unpaid in offer but state bridge payment conditional on completion and payable on first payroll.
legal-escalations: Approved clause language provided. If bridge paid on first payroll it will be included in pensionable earnings for the first pay period after start; include explicit language if you want it non-pensionable and we will evaluate but typically taxable and pensionable.
sam-people-ops: Update: manager approved at 2801234575, routing to finance now.
people-ops-bot: Finance approval pending (ticket PEOPLE-99882). Last action needed: finance sign-off for GBP 3,000 one-off.
